title: Weekly check-in
description: A short weekly check-in that uses what LIMA remembers about the student.

steps.text: On a scale of one to five, how has your week been?

low.text: I'm sorry it's been a rough week. What has been the hardest part?
acks: Thank you for telling me. That sounds hard.

low.reason: Student rated their week as low.

mid.text: Thanks. Sounds like a pretty normal week, with some ups and downs.

high.text: Awesome, I'm glad it's been a good week!

steps.text: Last time you mentioned {profile.classes}. How are those classes going?
How are your classes going so far?
Have you had any time for {profile.hobbies} this week?

yes.text: Nice! Making time for things you enjoy really helps.

no.text: That's okay. Even twenty minutes for something you enjoy can make a difference.

steps.text: How have you been sleeping lately?
acks: Thanks. Sleep makes a big difference for how everything else feels.

steps.text: Is there anything you'd like your Peer Mentor to know or help with?
acks: Got it. I'll pass that along.
